cards.card_text: Some say, "I follow Paul," others say, "I follow Apollos," an eloquent man who knew the Scriptures well (Acts 18:24), and others say, "I follow Cephas," that's Peter (John 1:42).
cards.verse_text: What I mean is this: Individuals among you are saying, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” or “I follow Christ.”
cards.snippet: …among you are saying, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” or “I follow Christ.”

cards.card_text: Then Paul says, “All things are yours,” whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas (that’s Peter, John 1:42), or the world, life, death, the present or the future.
